hints.title: Algebraic Formula
hints.text: After m forward jumps and d down moves, the current position is 2^m - d.

hints.title: Non-consecutive Invariant
hints.text: Since down moves cannot be executed consecutively, at most m + 1 down moves can be placed among m jumps.

hints.title: Combinations
hints.text: For each valid jump count m where 0 <= 2^m - k <= m + 1, the number of ways is comb(m + 1, 2^m - k).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterates at most 32 times because jump lengths double exponentially.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct state tree recursion can repeat states and branch excessively.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) time and space via direct mathematical combination.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduce the closed-form coordinate equation 2^m - d = k and combinatorial slotting.
